purpose: Index materialized official OnePlus/OPPO OTA or ROM artifacts without redistributing proprietary contents.
accepted_sources: official OnePlus Software Upgrade / local-upgrade packages
official OnePlus Community rollback packages published by OnePlus software staff
official OPPO System Upgrade / ColorOS packages

derived evidence is not a license grant to redistribute source artifacts
